title: First KIts were great, last few have been questionable
text: I loved my first couple of kits.  Full of current crafts and lots of materials.  Then they started to go down in value.  The last kit was a metal ring and plastic greenery to make a wreath.  Not worth the price.  The kits do have everything you need but the instructions could have more detail.  A one page instruction sheet for resin pour was lacking in detail and confusing.  Having to go on line for more instruction for the embroidery kit was irritating.  Made the kit hard to work on unless you had internet connection, or if you decided to take it for something to do while waiting and didn't read the instructions before hand. Waiting for this months kit to arrive to see if I decide to renew my subscription.
label: neutral
